# PFP and avatar sets

**One recognisable face or mark on every platform: circle-first design, a 2048 master, exact exports, and variants that don't break identity.**

Designs profile pictures and avatar sets that read as one identity everywhere — for AI characters, agents, creators and coins — with a circle-first composition that still works at 32 px, a 2048 px square master, exports per platform (X 400×400 under 2 MB, YouTube 800×800, Bluesky under 1,000,000 bytes, a 1000 px coin image), small-size circle previews, rules for which variants are allowed (seasonal, event, launch) and which parts stay locked, and an avatar register. Use when making or refreshing a pfp, avatar, profile picture or channel icon, giving an agent or coin a face, building a matching set across X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Telegram, Discord, Bluesky or Farcaster, or when avatars have drifted apart across platforms.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | beginner | 45 min for a set, 10 min per variant | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Pick the identity anchor
2. Design for the circle at 48 px
3. Generate the master square
4. Score small, fix, then lock the master
5. Export every size with the script
6. Define the variant rules
7. Set up coin and agent avatars
8. Upload, label and register
9. Audit the set every quarter

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/pfp-and-avatar-sets.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/pfp-and-avatar-sets.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/pfp-and-avatar-sets.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/pfp-and-avatar-sets.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill pfp-and-avatar-sets`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `pfp-and-avatar-sets.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/pfp-and-avatar-sets`.
